item.title: Man shot, killed by METRO police in downtown Houston, police say
item.description: The shooting happened around 9 a.m. Sunday at a METRORail platform at Main Street and Bell Street.

item.title: Nick Reiner pleads not guilty in LA slayings of parents Rob and Michele Reiner
item.description: Nick Reiner pleaded not guilty in a downtown Los Angeles courtroom Monday in connection with the killings of his parents, Hollywood director Rob Reiner and his wife, Michele Singer Reiner, late last year.

item.title: Man shot, killed by HPD police outside southwest Houston hotel
item.description: A man was shot and killed by Houston police outside of a hotel in southwest Houston on Sunday morning after he fired a rifle, police said.

item.title: Texas governor orders DPS 'surge' to border region after cartel leader killed
item.description: Gov. Greg Abbott said in his press release that cartels pose a "significant threat to public safety and national security."

item.title: Former Houston Rockets guard Patrick Beverley cleared of family assault charge
item.description: Beverley, 37, was arrested at his home in Rosharon back in November in a “family violence” incident, according to the Fort Bend County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: Pastor killed in accidental shooting during burglary attempt, HPD says
item.description: A pastor was accidentally shot and killed by his roommate in an incident over the weekend, Houston police said.

item.title: More than 2,000 riders hit the trail ahead of 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo
item.description: More than 2,000 riders are crossing Texas for the 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo. Follow all 12 trail ride routes and maps here.

item.title: Caddo fire burns 175 acres in northeast Houston, 30% contained
item.description: The Caddo Fire in northeast Houston has burned 175 acres and is 30% contained. Residents are urged to stay vigilant and be prepared to evacuate.

item.title: Cool start to the week, then 80s return
item.description: A cold front moved through Saturday, and now we are on the cooler, sunnier side of it for Sunday and Monday.

item.title: Camp Mystic parents sue state, accusing Texas officials of failing to enforce evacuation plan requirement
item.description: The families of nine Hill Country flooding victims filed the lawsuit in federal court on Monday, seeking damages and “all other relief that is equitable”.
